long_biography.plain_text:
Klump entered real estate while studying at the University of Colorado Boulder, obtaining a licence and selling houses before an internship introduced him to shopping-centre development. He later co-founded Equity Investment Group, where nine years of acquisitions built experience in selecting, financing and scaling retail property portfolios.

In 2003 he established two Atlanta platforms with different mandates. RCG Ventures acquires and develops multi-tenant shopping centres, while Argonne Capital backs independently capitalised middle-market companies with flexible ownership periods. His philanthropy endowed the university's real-estate centre, three faculty positions, student scholarships and student-wellbeing programmes.
